structure: Piano introduction 79.1.1 to 79.2.1 (voice rests, 4 bars). Repeat A: start-repeat before 80.2.2, 1st ending 80.4.1 (back to 80.2.2), 2nd ending 80.4.2. Repeat B: start-repeat at 81.1.1, 1st ending 81.2.2 (back to 81.1.1), 2nd ending 81.3.1. Repeat C (voice rests, piano interlude): start-repeat before 82.3.2, 1st ending 82.4.2 (back), 2nd ending 83.1.1. "To Coda" sign after 83.4.2; "da capo al coda" under 84.1.1; coda 84.1.2 to 84.3.2 (G5 under a fermata, F#5 and G5 eighths, then A5 held through two bars and an eighth). Verse 2 text is printed below the music on p.84 (same music). playback = the verse-1 pass with repeats A and B expanded (1st ending the first time, 2nd ending the second time), repeat C played once (rests, 2nd ending), then straight to the coda via To Coda (84.1.1 skipped, as in the second verse). playback_short = the same without the second time through A and B.
